name: Amanpreet Singh
bio: Amanpreet Singh is a co-founder and former CTO of Contextual AI. They previously led research and engineering teams at Hugging Face and Meta AI Research, and are first author of FLAVA, a vision-and-language alignment model, and a co-author of the MMF multimodal framework and GRIT.
